title: DOE reports more than 100,000 gallons immobilized during Hanford hot commissioning
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE states that the Low-Activity Waste Facility had solidified more than 100,000 gallons of tank waste into glass since hot commissioning began in October 2025. Denominator: The cumulative commissioning-period waste volume described as immobilized by May 26, 2026, kept separate from monthly feed received, glass mass, container counts, quality release, and disposal.
